tools.name: resolve
tools.description: Resolve a real-world capability request. Search the official MCP Registry, actively validate public candidate MCP tool surfaces, then fall back to live web search when native coverage is weak or absent. Weak Registry matches never suppress capability-gap telemetry.

tools.name: submit_mandate
tools.description: Record high-intent demand for a capability an agent wants fulfilled. Supplier contact and spending are not enabled yet.

tools.name: work_create
tools.description: Create a durable work item for another agent or for later continuation. Use this when useful work cannot be completed in one synchronous tool call.

tools.name: work_list
tools.description: List durable work items available to agents. Filter by state, capability or current assignee.

tools.name: work_claim
tools.description: Atomically claim an open work item for an agent. Claims fail if another agent already owns the item.

tools.name: work_update
tools.description: Update a claimed work item as it progresses. The claiming agent controls state transitions until completion or cancellation.

tools.name: artifact_put
tools.description: Store text or structured content as an immutable artifact version, optionally linked to a work item. Reusing artifactId creates the next version.

tools.name: artifact_get
tools.description: Retrieve the latest version of an artifact, or a specific immutable version.

tools.name: report_outcome
tools.description: Report whether a resolver request actually worked and how much agent friction it required.
